investment_policy_en:
The fund aims to provide combined income and capital growth that is higher than that of the global emerging markets bond market (as measured by a composite index comprising 1/3 JPM EMBI Global Diversified Index, 1/3 JPM CEMBI Broad Diversified Index and 1/3 JPM GBI-EM Global Diversified Index), over any three-year period, while applying ESG criteria. At least 80% of the fund is invested in bonds issued by governments and companies in emerging markets.

It can also invest in emerging market currencies. Investments are selected based on an assessment of global, regional, and country-specific macroeconomic factors, followed by in-depth analysis of individual bond issuers.

The fund invests in securities that meet the ESG criteria, applying an exclusionary approach as described in the prospectus. The recommended holding period of this fund is three years.

In normal market conditions, the fund’s expected average leverage – how much it can increase its investment position by borrowing money or using derivatives – is 150% of its net asset value.
